# clang-format for .github/workflows/format.yml, pinned by version and wheel hash.
# Install into a virtual environment (Ubuntu's system Python refuses pip installs, PEP 668):
#   python3 -m venv <dir>
#   <dir>/bin/pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps -r .github/tools/requirements-format.txt
# Hashes from https://pypi.org/pypi/clang-format/23.1.3/json (wheels for Linux x86_64/aarch64,
# Windows x64/arm64 and macOS). Any clang-format 23.1.x formats this code the same way.
